pay_detail: 2026 tuition was $4,985 per two-week session, or $9,970 for both. 2027 rates not yet posted. Limited tuition assistance is available.
duration: 2 weeks per session. Session 1: July 3 to 16, 2027. Session 2: July 18 to 31, 2027.
name: Summer Science and Engineering Program (SSEP)
what_you_do: Take lab-based science and engineering courses with Smith faculty for two or four weeks while living on campus. No college credit is given.
who_can_apply: Students going into grades 9 to 12 with strong grades and drive. It is selective. The page says Smith does not treat people unfairly by sex or gender. Students from other countries can apply.
deadline_text: Application opens Dec 10, 2026. Priority deadline Feb 1, 2027. Tuition assistance deadline Mar 1, 2027. International deadline Mar 1, 2027. Closes May 1, 2027 or when full.
how_to_apply: Apply online with an essay, one letter from a teacher and a transcript. The fee goes up to $100 on Apr 15, 2027.
notes: Costs money. Apply early for the priority date and for aid.
